summary.text: Curtis Gibson is the Democratic nominee challenging incumbent Scott Franklin; his primary was canceled. He is a former Lake Wales City Commissioner and commercial property manager who has held a range of working jobs. He describes himself as a working-class voice and not a career politician.

paragraphs.text: Graduate of Lake Wales High School; earned an associate degree from Bryant & Stratton College (2017) and a bachelor's degree in interdisciplinary business studies from Kaiser University (2021).
Describes past jobs as a school board janitor, U.S. Postal Service mail carrier, Amazon Air employee and professional wrestler.
Served as a Lake Wales City Commissioner from 2017 to 2021.
Works as a commercial property and mall manager, according to his survey responses, which cite experience in local business growth and lease negotiations.
According to his survey responses, lives in Polk County with his wife, Danielle, five children and a foster child.
Advanced to the general election without a primary after the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary was canceled.
